snippet.title: 【Dinotica】Official Early Access Launch | Available Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
THE WAIT IS OVER, Dino Tamers! 🦖🎉
We’re opening the gates to Dinotica’s wild prehistoric world TODAY!
Jump in, build your base, hatch your dinos, and take on epic bosses in Early Access on Steam! 

💥 Play Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336520/Dinotica/

🌟 Follow our official pages for the latest updates:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/official_dinotica
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DinoticaGame
X (Twitter): https://x.com/_dinotica
Discord: https://discord.gg/gyqjuwm7a7
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dinoticagame

🫵 It’s your world. Your dinos. Your uprising.
#DinoTopia #SteamGame #EarlyAccess #IndieGame #StrategyGame #Sandbox
